title: Register Google OAuth clients
description:
Human action, not code. First link in the critical path.

One Google Cloud project, one OAuth client per environment, redirect URIs pointing at the Cognito auth domain rather than the app (auth-dev.chattic.us, auth-staging.chattic.us, auth.chattic.us — single-label names so *.chattic.us covers them).

Secrets go directly into Secrets Manager by hand. Never the repository, CDK templates, or agent transcripts.

comments.author: rap@endymion.com
comments.text: Human-owned. Agents will not put Google client secrets in git. One GCP project, three OAuth clients, redirects to Cognito auth-dev / auth-staging / auth.chattic.us. Secrets Manager by hand.

comments.author: rap@endymion.com
comments.text:
## Human / architect — Google OAuth (critical path)

This is not agent-implementable without you.

Please confirm or correct:

- One Google Cloud project, **three** OAuth clients (dev / staging / prod).
- Redirect URIs are Cognito auth domains, **not** hey/dev/staging app origins: `https://auth-dev.chattic.us/oauth2/idpresponse`, `https://auth-staging.chattic.us/oauth2/idpresponse`, `https://auth.chattic.us/oauth2/idpresponse` (single DNS label so `*.chattic.us` covers them).
- Client secrets go to **Secrets Manager by hand**. Never git, never CDK plaintext, never an agent transcript.

If a GCP project and branding already exist, drop the project name (not secrets) here so Cognito work (0df6cb) can name the right ids later.
